(I)--An उपद्वीप to जम्बूद्वीप: a terri- torial division of शाल्मलिद्वीप:
1: भा. V. १९. ३०; २०. 9.
The island where कालीय originally lived. Here the serpents agreed to give बलि every fortnight to गरुड, except कालीय.
2: Ib. X. १६. ६३; १

.
South of श्वेत and north of नील. People live here for thousands of years (१०१५० years वा। प्।) by drinking the juice of the fruit of the banyan tree, रोहण in the island; people living there, pleasant to look at, devoid of disease and difficulties.
3: Br. II. १५ 62-5; M. ११३. ६१; वा. ४
(II)--son of वीतिहोत्र of पुष्करद्वीप. भा. V. २०. ३१.

(I)--Balabhadra of the यादव race and lord of द्वारका. (बलराम): brother of कृष्ण and सुभद्रा; See Baladeva; eldest son of Vasudeva by रोहिनी; father of two sons; welcomed कृष्ण to द्वारका; asked by कृष्ण to take one of the two heavenly chariots and get ready to fight जरासन्ध. राम blew his conch and began fighting [page३-072+ ४४] under his palmyra ensign; defeated the enemies on all sides. Fastened जरासन्ध with ropes but कृष्ण set him free; when जरासन्ध encamped on the यमुना, was consulted by कृष्ण; fought successfully जरासन्ध a third time and defeated बाण's army; when about to give a death-blow to जरासन्ध, a voice from the welkin said “do not kill जरासन्ध; go back.” Thus जरासन्ध was allowed to go back to his city.
1: भा. I. ११. १६; X. ५०. १२-32; [५० (v) 8]; [५१ (v) ३८-58]; [५२ (v) 1-6]; Br. III. ६१. २५; ७१. १६४-8; M. ४६. ११; वा. ८६. ३०; ९६. १६२; Vi.

; १३. १६.
Honoured by the याधव sabha, went with कृष्ण to the Gomanta hill; on the way met and bowed to परशुराम; helped कृष्ण in killing शृगाल Vas4udeva and was welcomed by the citizens of करवीरपुर. Stayed in this city for four months and returned to मथुरा with his brother. Attacked by जरासन्ध's army, fled with कृष्ण to Gomanta, pursued by जरासन्ध; reached द्वारका safe.
2: भा. X. [५२ (v) १३-41]; [५३(v) 1-२२]; ५२. 5-6 [5-7]; 7. १४ [1 and 2].
Married रेवती before the advent of Kali and hence very tall in appearance; with his plough he brought down her height to his level.
3: Ib. X. ५२. १५ [११-12].
Heard of कृष्ण going alone to कुण्डिन and of the pre- parations of Caidya to fight him; went with his army to कुण्डिन and was welcomed by its king: Attacked Caidya's party pursuing कृष्ण and रुक्मिणी on that account.
4: Ib. X. ५३. २०-21 and ३२; Ch. ५४ (whole).
Went to हास्तिनपुर with कृष्ण after the reported burning of the पाण्डवस् and कुन्ती: Pursued शतधन्वन् with कृष्ण and finding he had not the स्यमन्त in his person, sent कृष्ण back to द्वारका and himself to मिथिला as Janaka's guest; taught the use of the गदा (mace) to Duryodhana. Did not agree with कृष्ण in returning the jewel to अक्रूर. Left for Videha after Satadhanvan's death.
5: Ib. X. ५७ (whole) ; ५८. 9 [4 and 5]; ६७ (v) ४२.
Attended Aniruddha's marriage at भोजकट where induced by Kalinga and other friends, Rukmin invited राम for a game of dice: in it, राम sometimes lost and sometimes gained. At his loss Kalinga laughed showing his teeth. When Rukmin played false it was referred to [page३-073+ ३८] a mediator who was unfortunately Kalinga and who there- fore maintained that Rukmi was in the right. A voice from the air said: “Rukmi tells an untruth”. Without heeding to this Rukmi insulted राम as a forester and herdsman and new to the art of dice. राम got enraged, took the mace and vanquished Rukmi: next he pulled out the teeth of Kalinga making fun of him all the time: others fled in fear; returned to द्वारका.
6: Ib. X. ६१. २६-40.
His picture was among those drawn by चित्रालेखा: In- vaded बाण's city, fought with कुम्भाण्ड and कूप- कर्ण. Once drove to Vraja and spent two months there. During nights he sported and sang with Gopis on the यमुना drinking वारुणी and playing in the waters: changed the course of the river by his plough:
7: Ib. X. ६२. २०; ६

.
यमुना (s.v.) presented him with clothes, and ornaments with which he shone brighter than ever.
8: Ib. X. Ch. ६५ (whole).
Desire for more territory.
9: Ib.

.
Wanted to give सुभद्रा in marriage to Duryodhana but कृष्ण was for her marriage with Arjuna. The latter went to द्वारका as an ascetic when राम one day invited him for भिक्ष। It was an opportunity for Arjuna and सुभद्रा to see each other. Arjuna carried her away on a festive occasion with कृष्ण's consent. राम's wrath was pacified by कृष्ण. Then he approved of the marriage and sent him presents.
१०: Ib. X. ८

, १८.
Unable to recover the dead son of the द्वा- रका Bra1hman2a.
११: Ib. X. ८९, ३१ and ४१.
Founded the city of Govardhana on the upper regions of the गोदावरी in the northern part of the Sahya mountain.
१२: Br. II. १६. ४४.
The God of Love cursed to be born as the brother of कृष्ण at द्वारका.
१३:

(II)--a son of दशरथ known for his righteous- ness and truth: परिक्षित् compared to him: An अवतार् of Hari born in the इक्ष्वाकु line; killed रावण; His fame equalled that of पृथु.
1: भा. I. १२. १९;

. ८७-102, १०४.
led an exemplary household life, by his loyalty to his wedded wife; performed sacrifices by giv- ing all his kingdom as दक्षिण, retaining only the ornaments and dress, and for सीता, her सौमान्गल्य। The Brahmanas returned the kingdom as they had no use for it and praised him.
3: भा. IX. १०. ५३-6; १

(III) (परशुराम)--a son of Jamadagni and रेणुका; an अम्श of Hari. Heard from his father that Arjuna-Haihaya had taken कामधेनु against his wish, and getting angry went to Haihaya's capital, cut off the king's head and took back the cow. In order to get rid of the sin of killing a king, he went on तीर्थयात्र for a year.
1: भा. IX. १५. १३ to the end. Br.

. ९८; ६६. ६३; ६९. ४८; M. ४३. ४०; २८५. 7.
In obedience to his father's command he killed his mother and brothers. This pleased the father and by his boon to his son, they all came back to life. During his absence, the sons of Haihaya killed his father, and on his return, found his mother crying over the death of Jamadagni. He took his axe, ran to माहिष्मती, rooted out all the क्षत्रियस् by defeating them twenty-one times; with their blood he made nine pools at स्यमन्तपञ्चक, where he worshipped his father's dead body and distributed the various regions to the priests; ended it with अवभृत in the सरस्वती।
2: भा. IX. १

; M. २७३. ६६.
He would be a great sage in the forthcoming मन्वन्तर। A sage of the 8th मन्वन्तर। Even today resides in Mahen- dra contemplating on Hari;
3: भा. VIII. १३. १५; IX. १६. २५-7.
was invited for the राजसूय of युधिष्ठिर and came to see कृष्ण at स्यमन्तपञ्चक.
4: Ib. X. ७४. 9; ८४. 4.
In his early years, with the leave of his parents, he visited his grand parents ऋचीक and सत्यवती; and after some stay there, called on his great grandfather भृगु, who advised [page३-076+ ३४] him to do तपस् in the हिमालयस् in honour of शिव. Engaged in तपस् by standing in water in the winter and on the fire in summer, by means of पद्मासन; शिव in hunter's guise visited him and asked him to quit his place. Suspecting him to be god, राम, appealed to him when शिव showed his true form. Instructed by शिव, he went round the earth on a pilgrimage tour. Helped the Devas in routing the Asuras; continued his तपस् by worshipping शिव as मृग- व्याध. Pleased, the Lord instructed him in the अस्त्र- ग्राम in its four aspects; went to ब्रह्मा for advice before he started on his crusade against the क्षत्रियस्. Advised to meet शिव and to get initiated into कृष्णमन्त्र कवचम्; शिव instructed him with त्रैलोक्य विजयम् मन्त्रम्। On his way back he stayed at पुष्कर and heard a male deer narrating the story of परशुराम and अकृतव्रण to the female deer, adding that his was not the उत्तम भक्ति but the मध्यम। He took the hint from that conversation that he would achieve his end by Agastya's grace. राम repaired to the hermitage of Agastya, followed by the deer.

1: Br. II. १४. ४६-50; वा. ३३. ३९, ४२.

--the nineteenth अवतार् of Hari born among the वृष्णिस्. भा.

--a R.; the महानदी touching the hill of प्रभास where राम bathed with his wife; all sins com- mitted in a hundred generations vanish as a result of a bath in this तीर्थ;
